name: COPY
desc: COPY value construction, replacement of every basic JSON type, path resolution and auto-vivification, sequential assignments, namespace access, and logical cloning. Error flags include the least severe runtime failure and stronger diagnoses justified by static analysis. No resource limits or optional features are required.

tests.name: TEMP does not persist across COPY actions
tests.desc: A minimalist interpreter reads a missing temporary; static analysis can prove the first action's temporary is unavailable in the second for every input.

tests.desc: The first assignment guarantees a scalar parent, so the failure is independent of the input.

tests.name: An intentional FAIL is never upgraded
tests.desc: Intentional expression failures remain INVALID_TARGET even when known statically.
